d:
Jharkhand men chakravati tuphan 'arnab' ka asar ab kamjor parne laga hai, lekin pichhle do dinon ki barish ne rajy ke mausam ka mijaj badal diya hai. rajdhani ranchi samet kaee ilakon men tapman men sat digri tak ki giravat darj ki gaee hai. barish aur thandi havaon ke karan logon ko thand ka ehsas hone laga hai.
Dusri taraph lagatar barish se kisanon ki chinta barh gaee hai. kheton men taiyar dhan ki phasal ko nuksan pahunchne ki khabren samne aa rahi hain. tej hava aur jalajmav se phasal girne aur kharab hone ka khatra bhi barh gaya hai.
